legal.description: Promotion and Regulation of Online Gaming Act, 2025: blanket ban on real-money online games (fantasy, rummy, poker); up to 3 yrs jail, Rs 1 Cr fine; banks barred from servicing RMG. Games24x7 suspended RMG offerings Sept 2025.
28% GST on entire entry fee (not just platform fee/GGR) effective Oct 1, 2023. Bhavin Pandya (Nov 2022) stated this would make the business unviable. Previously 18% GST on platform fees (GGR).
Tamil Nadu and Karnataka suspended online games involving money transfer in 2022; both later overturned by respective state high courts.
Post-Online Gaming Act 2025, RMG firms suspended offerings across states; multiple state-level bans and enforcement actions against real-money gaming platforms.
